headline: Tanker Owner Frontline Posts Q3 Net Profit of $641.4 Million
summary: International tanker operator Frontline plc reported third-quarter net profit of $641.4 million, or $2.88 per share, and declared a cash dividend payout of $2.38 per share.
why: Frontline is a leading international tanker shipping firm operating large crude carriers across worldwide trade routes.

impacts.name: Frontline
impacts.why: Third-quarter net profit and dividend declaration reflect current seaborne tanker charter market rates.
